description:
"Live with me starting today."

Hyerin, Yeonwoo's best friend and roommate, ran off on a romantic getaway with her boyfriend.   
Yeonwoo expected Doheon—her landlord, Hyerin's older brother, and her long-time unrequited crush—to just kick her out.  

"I'm telling you to move into my place."

Claiming he'll act as her guardian, he proposes that they live together, just the two of them.   
Ultimately, Yeonwoo ends up moving into Doheon's penthouse.  
However, the more time they spend together, the stranger he acts.

"Because I don't think I'll be able to leave you alone anymore."

With an undisguised, burning gaze, he keeps closing the distance between them.    
As if he's about to devour even the ten-year age gap and the guilt of her being his sister's friend.
